# rtwKit architecture notes

This directory records non-obvious architectural contracts for rtwKit.

- `architecture.md` — repository boundaries and Core vs Extension Manager responsibilities.
- `distribution.md` — RTW packaging, releases, registry metadata, updates, and manual install.
- `development.md` — development-mode loading, one-click install intents, and implementation order.

These are project architecture notes, not Rintawa Core specifications. rtwKit is intentionally replaceable.
